meta.title: Wicked Illusions
meta.description: Phantoms separated by the merest of margins stymie the lost points of light.

units.rawText: In the Middle Ring of the Tartarus Sector.
units.displayText: In the Middle Ring of the Tartarus Sector.

spans.text: In the Middle Ring of the Tartarus Sector.

units.rawText: After leaving the ruins of Watchtower [objectTower_b2], Eos and I head into the depths of the labyrinth.
units.displayText: After leaving the ruins of Watchtower [objectTower_b2], Eos and I head into the depths of the labyrinth.

spans.text: After leaving the ruins of Watchtower [objectTower_b2], Eos and I head into the depths of the labyrinth.

units.rawText: Along the way, massive walls clash and intersect while Entropics loom in and out of view. The natives of Tartarus Sector stubbornly protest our presence in their own way.
units.displayText: Along the way, massive walls clash and intersect while Entropics loom in and out of view. The natives of Tartarus Sector stubbornly protest our presence in their own way.

spans.text: Along the way, massive walls clash and intersect while Entropics loom in and out of view. The natives of Tartarus Sector stubbornly protest our presence in their own way.

units.rawText: Crack—
units.displayText: Crack—

spans.text: Crack—

units.rawText: After turning the corner, another group of monstrous bodies break apart, crumble, and disintegrate before my eyes.
units.displayText: After turning the corner, another group of monstrous bodies break apart, crumble, and disintegrate before my eyes.

spans.text: After turning the corner, another group of monstrous bodies break apart, crumble, and disintegrate before my eyes.

units.rawText: What's wrong? You look like you want to say something, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: What's wrong? You look like you want to say something, {교수}.

spans.text: What's wrong? You look like you want to say something,

units.rawText: It's nothing. I just want to note that your strength and that of Eosphorus are on a completely different level from the other Greater Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: It's nothing. I just want to note that your strength and that of Eosphorus are on a completely different level from the other Greater Sanctifiers.

spans.text: It's nothing. I just want to note that your strength and that of Eosphorus are on a completely different level from the other Greater Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: I downloaded some combat support modules from my database to help ease some of the stress on you, but I guess it wasn't necessary.
units.displayText: I downloaded some combat support modules from my database to help ease some of the stress on you, but I guess it wasn't necessary.

spans.text: I downloaded some combat support modules from my database to help ease some of the stress on you, but I guess it wasn't necessary.

units.rawText: Hehe. Well, Eosphorus IS one of the Sanctifiers' leaders, after all, and my existence... was for his sake.
units.displayText: Hehe. Well, Eosphorus IS one of the Sanctifiers' leaders, after all, and my existence... was for his sake.

spans.text: Hehe. Well, Eosphorus IS one of the Sanctifiers' leaders, after all, and my existence... was for his sake.

units.rawText: Don't worry about it, <cmdr>. Your specialty isn't combat. Your strengths lie in analysis and leadership, do they not?
units.displayText: Don't worry about it, {교수}. Your specialty isn't combat. Your strengths lie in analysis and leadership, do they not?

spans.text: Don't worry about it,
. Your specialty isn't combat. Your strengths lie in analysis and leadership, do they not?

units.rawText: ...I'll consider that praise.
units.displayText: ...I'll consider that praise.

spans.text: ...I'll consider that praise.

units.rawText: With a sigh, I return the short sword that I haven't even fully drawn back to its sheath and once again bring up the Rubik's Map to confirm our path forward.
units.displayText: With a sigh, I return the short sword that I haven't even fully drawn back to its sheath and once again bring up the Rubik's Map to confirm our path forward.

spans.text: With a sigh, I return the short sword that I haven't even fully drawn back to its sheath and once again bring up the Rubik's Map to confirm our path forward.

units.rawText: Teehee... seeing you this crestfallen is something new, <cmdr>. It's kind of cute, and different from my usual impression of you.
units.displayText: Teehee... seeing you this crestfallen is something new, {교수}. It's kind of cute, and different from my usual impression of you.

spans.text: Teehee... seeing you this crestfallen is something new,
. It's kind of cute, and different from my usual impression of you.

units.rawText: You've already done very well. Also, keeping the elite Entropics from catching up with us is more than a little useful.
units.displayText: You've already done very well. Also, keeping the elite Entropics from catching up with us is more than a little useful.

spans.text: You've already done very well. Also, keeping the elite Entropics from catching up with us is more than a little useful.

units.rawText: Honestly, with Electra badly wounded and Alcyone out of it, if you hadn't helped buy them time, I dare not imagine what would have happened to them...
units.displayText: Honestly, with Electra badly wounded and Alcyone out of it, if you hadn't helped buy them time, I dare not imagine what would have happened to them...

spans.text: Honestly, with Electra badly wounded and Alcyone out of it, if you hadn't helped buy them time, I dare not imagine what would have happened to them...

units.rawText: Eos shakes her head, as though she doesn't want to keep discussing the topic further, and shifts her gaze to the Rubik's Map in my hands.
units.displayText: Eos shakes her head, as though she doesn't want to keep discussing the topic further, and shifts her gaze to the Rubik's Map in my hands.

spans.text: Eos shakes her head, as though she doesn't want to keep discussing the topic further, and shifts her gaze to the Rubik's Map in my hands.

units.rawText: It's because we're all different that we need each other, just like interlocking pieces of a jigsaw puzzle.
units.displayText: It's because we're all different that we need each other, just like interlocking pieces of a jigsaw puzzle.

spans.text: It's because we're all different that we need each other, just like interlocking pieces of a jigsaw puzzle.

units.rawText: Diversity is our strength, so why be frustrated by it? All you need to do is what you're good at doing.
units.displayText: Diversity is our strength, so why be frustrated by it? All you need to do is what you're good at doing.

spans.text: Diversity is our strength, so why be frustrated by it? All you need to do is what you're good at doing.

units.rawText: How you point out the way forward and remind everyone to avoid traps is also quite charming.
units.displayText: How you point out the way forward and remind everyone to avoid traps is also quite charming.

spans.text: How you point out the way forward and remind everyone to avoid traps is also quite charming.

units.rawText: Even if you say that...
units.displayText: Even if you say that...

spans.text: Even if you say that...

units.rawText: Just as my voice trails off, another pack of Entropics comes into view. Eos obliterates them with a wave of her hand before they can even announce themselves with their cries.
units.displayText: Just as my voice trails off, another pack of Entropics comes into view. Eos obliterates them with a wave of her hand before they can even announce themselves with their cries.

spans.text: Just as my voice trails off, another pack of Entropics comes into view. Eos obliterates them with a wave of her hand before they can even announce themselves with their cries.

units.rawText: However, just then, I sense something out of place in the Rubik's Map just as I put it away.
units.displayText: However, just then, I sense something out of place in the Rubik's Map just as I put it away.

spans.text: However, just then, I sense something out of place in the Rubik's Map just as I put it away.

units.rawText: Hold on, Eos.
units.displayText: Hold on, Eos.

spans.text: Hold on, Eos.

units.rawText: Are you still upset? In that case, why don't I leave you a few for a warm up during our next encounter?
units.displayText: Are you still upset? In that case, why don't I leave you a few for a warm up during our next encounter?

spans.text: Are you still upset? In that case, why don't I leave you a few for a warm up during our next encounter?

units.rawText: (Clears throat) Uh, there's no need for that. Let's talk about "what I'm good at doing"—
units.displayText: (Clears throat) Uh, there's no need for that. Let's talk about "what I'm good at doing"—

spans.text: (Clears throat) Uh, there's no need for that. Let's talk about "what I'm good at doing"—

units.rawText: Have you noticed something strange about the frequency and timing of the Entropic attacks on us?
units.displayText: Have you noticed something strange about the frequency and timing of the Entropic attacks on us?

spans.text: Have you noticed something strange about the frequency and timing of the Entropic attacks on us?

units.rawText: I wave my hand to disperse the sense of oppression I was feeling just now, then bring the Rubik's Map before Eos' eyes, indicating that she should view it with me.
units.displayText: I wave my hand to disperse the sense of oppression I was feeling just now, then bring the Rubik's Map before Eos' eyes, indicating that she should view it with me.

spans.text: I wave my hand to disperse the sense of oppression I was feeling just now, then bring the Rubik's Map before Eos' eyes, indicating that she should view it with me.

units.rawText: Every time the walls move, whenever we reach a junction, or when the traps activate, we get ambushed by Entropics.
units.displayText: Every time the walls move, whenever we reach a junction, or when the traps activate, we get ambushed by Entropics.

spans.text: Every time the walls move, whenever we reach a junction, or when the traps activate, we get ambushed by Entropics.

units.rawText: Isn't that a normal development? I'd attack at times like these if I were an enemy.
units.displayText: Isn't that a normal development? I'd attack at times like these if I were an enemy.

spans.text: Isn't that a normal development? I'd attack at times like these if I were an enemy.

units.rawText: Problem is, they're being TOO precise with the timing of their ambushes. Their attack patterns are far too similar... It's almost as though they were ambushing us just because.
units.displayText: Problem is, they're being TOO precise with the timing of their ambushes. Their attack patterns are far too similar... It's almost as though they were ambushing us just because.

spans.text: Problem is, they're being TOO precise with the timing of their ambushes. Their attack patterns are far too similar... It's almost as though they were ambushing us just because.

units.rawText: I share the real-time optical data display that I'm using with Eos and highlight several items.
units.displayText: I share the real-time optical data display that I'm using with Eos and highlight several items.

spans.text: I share the real-time optical data display that I'm using with Eos and highlight several items.

units.rawText: Do you see? Once the rate of change and trend reach these thresholds, a pack of Entropics shows up in front of us, as though it were planned.
units.displayText: Do you see? Once the rate of change and trend reach these thresholds, a pack of Entropics shows up in front of us, as though it were planned.

spans.text: Do you see? Once the rate of change and trend reach these thresholds, a pack of Entropics shows up in front of us, as though it were planned.

units.rawText: Hm—
units.displayText: Hm—

spans.text: Hm—

units.rawText: Eos rubs her chin thoughtfully.
units.displayText: Eos rubs her chin thoughtfully.

spans.text: Eos rubs her chin thoughtfully.

units.rawText: I wonder if I should get a second neural cloud system installed...
units.displayText: I wonder if I should get a second neural cloud system installed...

spans.text: I wonder if I should get a second neural cloud system installed...

units.rawText: I'm just kidding. Your system interface is way too complicated, <cmdr>. I'm having some difficulty handling the data flow.
units.displayText: I'm just kidding. Your system interface is way too complicated, {교수}. I'm having some difficulty handling the data flow.

spans.text: I'm just kidding. Your system interface is way too complicated,
. I'm having some difficulty handling the data flow.

units.rawText: The categories you've highlighted do seem problematic, but that's as far as my analysis went. What do you think?
units.displayText: The categories you've highlighted do seem problematic, but that's as far as my analysis went. What do you think?

spans.text: The categories you've highlighted do seem problematic, but that's as far as my analysis went. What do you think?

units.rawText: So you can't see anything else either? In that case... Hm... I need to study the possibilities...
units.displayText: So you can't see anything else either? In that case... Hm... I need to study the possibilities...

spans.text: So you can't see anything else either? In that case... Hm... I need to study the possibilities...

units.rawText: I bring up the map again and try to reproduce the labyrinth data during the previous Entropic attacks and examine the changes in the data from different angles. However—
units.displayText: I bring up the map again and try to reproduce the labyrinth data during the previous Entropic attacks and examine the changes in the data from different angles. However—

spans.text: I bring up the map again and try to reproduce the labyrinth data during the previous Entropic attacks and examine the changes in the data from different angles. However—

units.rawText: This isn't working. I don't have enough effective information. Not enough to produce any useful conclusions, at least.
units.displayText: This isn't working. I don't have enough effective information. Not enough to produce any useful conclusions, at least.

spans.text: This isn't working. I don't have enough effective information. Not enough to produce any useful conclusions, at least.

units.rawText: That's alright. There's still some time before we reach the Watchtower. We can still gather more information on our way there.
units.displayText: That's alright. There's still some time before we reach the Watchtower. We can still gather more information on our way there.

spans.text: That's alright. There's still some time before we reach the Watchtower. We can still gather more information on our way there.

units.rawText: Let me handle the other threats. Is there anything else that I can help you analyze?
units.displayText: Let me handle the other threats. Is there anything else that I can help you analyze?

spans.text: Let me handle the other threats. Is there anything else that I can help you analyze?

units.rawText: Please do your best to go easy on the enemies we encounter afterwards and observe their reactions. Let's see if we can learn something from them.
units.displayText: Please do your best to go easy on the enemies we encounter afterwards and observe their reactions. Let's see if we can learn something from them.

spans.text: Please do your best to go easy on the enemies we encounter afterwards and observe their reactions. Let's see if we can learn something from them.

units.rawText: Is that all? You can feel free to rely on me more, <cmdr>~
units.displayText: Is that all? You can feel free to rely on me more, {교수}~

spans.text: Is that all? You can feel free to rely on me more,

units.rawText: Pieces that are too squared off won't be able to fit together with their peers.
units.displayText: Pieces that are too squared off won't be able to fit together with their peers.

spans.text: Pieces that are too squared off won't be able to fit together with their peers.

units.rawText: You just need to stay on guard against any unexpected surprises. That's enough.
units.displayText: You just need to stay on guard against any unexpected surprises. That's enough.

spans.text: You just need to stay on guard against any unexpected surprises. That's enough.

units.rawText: Like you said, we just need to do what we're good at doing, Puzzle Piece Who's An Extremely Powerful Fighter No. 1.
units.displayText: Like you said, we just need to do what we're good at doing, Puzzle Piece Who's An Extremely Powerful Fighter No. 1.

spans.text: Like you said, we just need to do what we're good at doing, Puzzle Piece Who's An Extremely Powerful Fighter No. 1.

units.rawText: Pffft... Very well, Puzzle Piece With An Extremely Powerful Neural Cloud No. 2.
units.displayText: Pffft... Very well, Puzzle Piece With An Extremely Powerful Neural Cloud No. 2.

spans.text: Pffft... Very well, Puzzle Piece With An Extremely Powerful Neural Cloud No. 2.

units.rawText: Hehe... perhaps when we put all the pieces together, we'll be able to find the solution to all the mysteries surrounding the Tartarus Sector.
units.displayText: Hehe... perhaps when we put all the pieces together, we'll be able to find the solution to all the mysteries surrounding the Tartarus Sector.

spans.text: Hehe... perhaps when we put all the pieces together, we'll be able to find the solution to all the mysteries surrounding the Tartarus Sector.

units.rawText: I smile and nod, and then I focus all my attention on the slowly-shifting Rubik's Map and my data display. All my efforts are devoted to finding the truth lurking within... or perhaps, the threads of logic that run through them. Meanwhile, Eos watches our surroundings. A moment later, she suddenly continues our previous conversation.
units.displayText: I smile and nod, and then I focus all my attention on the slowly-shifting Rubik's Map and my data display. All my efforts are devoted to finding the truth lurking within... or perhaps, the threads of logic that run through them. Meanwhile, Eos watches our surroundings. A moment later, she suddenly continues our previous conversation.

spans.text: I smile and nod, and then I focus all my attention on the slowly-shifting Rubik's Map and my data display. All my efforts are devoted to finding the truth lurking within... or perhaps, the threads of logic that run through them. Meanwhile, Eos watches our surroundings. A moment later, she suddenly continues our previous conversation.

units.rawText: ...Still, it would be terrible if we got a picture of the Tartarus Sector if I were pieced together with you. Let's pick something else instead.
units.displayText: ...Still, it would be terrible if we got a picture of the Tartarus Sector if I were pieced together with you. Let's pick something else instead.

spans.text: ...Still, it would be terrible if we got a picture of the Tartarus Sector if I were pieced together with you. Let's pick something else instead.

units.rawText: Such as?
units.displayText: Such as?

spans.text: Such as?

units.rawText: Eos activates her detector module and slowly scans me from head to toe with what might be actual seriousness, before stopping at the symbol representing my status as a Sanctifier.
units.displayText: Eos activates her detector module and slowly scans me from head to toe with what might be actual seriousness, before stopping at the symbol representing my status as a Sanctifier.

spans.text: Eos activates her detector module and slowly scans me from head to toe with what might be actual seriousness, before stopping at the symbol representing my status as a Sanctifier.

units.rawText: Such as a picture that represents us, as Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: Such as a picture that represents us, as Sanctifiers.

spans.text: Such as a picture that represents us, as Sanctifiers.
Sounds great.
That was an unexpected answer.

units.rawText: I know, right? I'm sure something that represents the divine and the glory of the Sanctifiers will reassure everyone and give them strength.
units.displayText: I know, right? I'm sure something that represents the divine and the glory of the Sanctifiers will reassure everyone and give them strength.

spans.text: I know, right? I'm sure something that represents the divine and the glory of the Sanctifiers will reassure everyone and give them strength.

units.rawText: I thought you'd go for something more interesting, or rather, more romantic... Instead you chose something that was surprisingly practical.
units.displayText: I thought you'd go for something more interesting, or rather, more romantic... Instead you chose something that was surprisingly practical.

spans.text: I thought you'd go for something more interesting, or rather, more romantic... Instead you chose something that was surprisingly practical.

units.rawText: In that case, what kind of picture would you choose, <cmdr>?
units.displayText: In that case, what kind of picture would you choose, {교수}?

spans.text: In that case, what kind of picture would you choose,
An Oasis.
Daybreak.
An expanse of white.

units.rawText: ...<color=orange>An Oasis?</color>
units.displayText: ...An Oasis?

spans.text: An Oasis?

units.rawText: After reflexively mentioning that word, I realize I have no idea why it came to mind.
units.displayText: After reflexively mentioning that word, I realize I have no idea why it came to mind.

spans.text: After reflexively mentioning that word, I realize I have no idea why it came to mind.

units.rawText: Are you talking about a place that shelters agents and gives people hope? ...I didn't expect an answer like that from you, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: Are you talking about a place that shelters agents and gives people hope? ...I didn't expect an answer like that from you, {교수}.

spans.text: Are you talking about a place that shelters agents and gives people hope? ...I didn't expect an answer like that from you,

units.rawText: Still, it sounds nice.
units.displayText: Still, it sounds nice.

spans.text: Still, it sounds nice.

units.rawText: Your namesake would be good.
units.displayText: Your namesake would be good.

spans.text: Your namesake would be good.

units.rawText: Huh?
units.displayText: Huh?

spans.text: Huh?

units.rawText: I'm talking about the faint light of daybreak after the dawn has come.
units.displayText: I'm talking about the faint light of daybreak after the dawn has come.

spans.text: I'm talking about the faint light of daybreak after the dawn has come.

units.rawText: If you're a piece of the puzzle, then the full picture would be hope.
units.displayText: If you're a piece of the puzzle, then the full picture would be hope.

spans.text: If you're a piece of the puzzle, then the full picture would be hope.

units.rawText: A blank white expanse doesn't count as a picture, you know.
units.displayText: A blank white expanse doesn't count as a picture, you know.

spans.text: A blank white expanse doesn't count as a picture, you know.

units.rawText: But a blank white expanse means it contains infinite possibilities.
units.displayText: But a blank white expanse means it contains infinite possibilities.

spans.text: But a blank white expanse means it contains infinite possibilities.

units.rawText: Not being limited to a single choice, being able to freely decide what you want it to be after putting it together... Don't you think that's quite romantic, too?
units.displayText: Not being limited to a single choice, being able to freely decide what you want it to be after putting it together... Don't you think that's quite romantic, too?

spans.text: Not being limited to a single choice, being able to freely decide what you want it to be after putting it together... Don't you think that's quite romantic, too?

units.rawText: Deciding what it means after the fact... Now that's an answer that is both unexpected yet very characteristic of you, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: Deciding what it means after the fact... Now that's an answer that is both unexpected yet very characteristic of you, {교수}.

spans.text: Deciding what it means after the fact... Now that's an answer that is both unexpected yet very characteristic of you,

units.rawText: I think about what the two of them said before we set out and laugh. Then I jokingly imitate them as I speak.
units.displayText: I think about what the two of them said before we set out and laugh. Then I jokingly imitate them as I speak.

spans.text: I think about what the two of them said before we set out and laugh. Then I jokingly imitate them as I speak.

units.rawText: Eos, the future of Magrasea is in our hands.
units.displayText: Eos, the future of Magrasea is in our hands.

spans.text: Eos, the future of Magrasea is in our hands.

units.rawText: In the Middle Ring of the Tartarus Sector.
units.displayText: In the Middle Ring of the Tartarus Sector.

spans.text: In the Middle Ring of the Tartarus Sector.

units.rawText: I advance deeper into the labyrinth with Eos, and as we get closer to our destination, the number of Entropics attacking us grows larger and larger. However, Eos' quick reactions mean that they do not pose a threat to us at any time.
units.displayText: I advance deeper into the labyrinth with Eos, and as we get closer to our destination, the number of Entropics attacking us grows larger and larger. However, Eos' quick reactions mean that they do not pose a threat to us at any time.

spans.text: I advance deeper into the labyrinth with Eos, and as we get closer to our destination, the number of Entropics attacking us grows larger and larger. However, Eos' quick reactions mean that they do not pose a threat to us at any time.

units.rawText: <cmdr>.
units.displayText: {교수}.

units.rawText: These numbers have come up quite a few times, maybe if I slotted them in here... Or here...
units.displayText: These numbers have come up quite a few times, maybe if I slotted them in here... Or here...

spans.text: These numbers have come up quite a few times, maybe if I slotted them in here... Or here...

units.rawText: <cmdr>!
units.displayText: {교수}!

units.rawText: Hm? Is something the matter, Eos?
units.displayText: Hm? Is something the matter, Eos?

spans.text: Hm? Is something the matter, Eos?

units.rawText: We've arrived.
units.displayText: We've arrived.

spans.text: We've arrived.

units.rawText: I look up from the vast fog of data and the ruined Watchtower known as [objectTower_b1] looms before us.
units.displayText: I look up from the vast fog of data and the ruined Watchtower known as [objectTower_b1] looms before us.

spans.text: I look up from the vast fog of data and the ruined Watchtower known as [objectTower_b1] looms before us.

units.rawText: Well, have you learned anything yet?
units.displayText: Well, have you learned anything yet?

spans.text: Well, have you learned anything yet?

units.rawText: Currently, we have been attacked 41 times and there are 148 sets of data linked to them.
units.displayText: Currently, we have been attacked 41 times and there are 148 sets of data linked to them.

spans.text: Currently, we have been attacked 41 times and there are 148 sets of data linked to them.

units.rawText: I tried using the Rubik's Map to replicate the changes in the data, but I haven't been able to identify any activity trends in the labyrinth.
units.displayText: I tried using the Rubik's Map to replicate the changes in the data, but I haven't been able to identify any activity trends in the labyrinth.

spans.text: I tried using the Rubik's Map to replicate the changes in the data, but I haven't been able to identify any activity trends in the labyrinth.

units.rawText: Do you think you might have been imagining things?
units.displayText: Do you think you might have been imagining things?

spans.text: Do you think you might have been imagining things?

units.rawText: Perhaps.
units.displayText: Perhaps.

spans.text: Perhaps.

units.rawText: I frown and verify that the coordinates of [objectTower_b1] on the Rubik's Map is correct, and then put it away.
units.displayText: I frown and verify that the coordinates of [objectTower_b1] on the Rubik's Map is correct, and then put it away.

spans.text: I frown and verify that the coordinates of [objectTower_b1] on the Rubik's Map is correct, and then put it away.

units.rawText: Do you have an estimate on the number of enemies inside the Watchtower? Do you need me to help with the scouting?
units.displayText: Do you have an estimate on the number of enemies inside the Watchtower? Do you need me to help with the scouting?

spans.text: Do you have an estimate on the number of enemies inside the Watchtower? Do you need me to help with the scouting?

units.rawText: No... The entire structure is very spacious. There are no enemies inside or any high-density operand sources.
units.displayText: No... The entire structure is very spacious. There are no enemies inside or any high-density operand sources.

spans.text: No... The entire structure is very spacious. There are no enemies inside or any high-density operand sources.

units.rawText: Could the Entropics have destroyed the Halo system inside and simply left?
units.displayText: Could the Entropics have destroyed the Halo system inside and simply left?

spans.text: Could the Entropics have destroyed the Halo system inside and simply left?

units.rawText: The video image shows that the Halo device is intact. At least, on the surface, it appears untouched.
units.displayText: The video image shows that the Halo device is intact. At least, on the surface, it appears untouched.

spans.text: The video image shows that the Halo device is intact. At least, on the surface, it appears untouched.

units.rawText: It's quiet... too quiet... I'm starting to feel uneasy.
units.displayText: It's quiet... too quiet... I'm starting to feel uneasy.

spans.text: It's quiet... too quiet... I'm starting to feel uneasy.

units.rawText: Don't worry, I'll protect you.
units.displayText: Don't worry, I'll protect you.

spans.text: Don't worry, I'll protect you.

units.rawText: We advance into the Watchtower one after the other. Eos is at my back, orienting herself in readiness for battle.
units.displayText: We advance into the Watchtower one after the other. Eos is at my back, orienting herself in readiness for battle.

spans.text: We advance into the Watchtower one after the other. Eos is at my back, orienting herself in readiness for battle.

units.rawText: Relax. No matter what schemes the Entropics might have, they'll have to face us head-on in the end.
units.displayText: Relax. No matter what schemes the Entropics might have, they'll have to face us head-on in the end.

spans.text: Relax. No matter what schemes the Entropics might have, they'll have to face us head-on in the end.

units.rawText: If they're gathered in one tower to ambush Eosphorus or Alcyone...
units.displayText: If they're gathered in one tower to ambush Eosphorus or Alcyone...

units.rawText: The best way to trick a smart person is to make them think something is wrong, assume a problem exists, and draw their own conclusions.
